from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, including which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper being parsed")
    references_to_collection: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")
    grounding_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the title or a reference to confirm identity")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
